notes: Seed URL works. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Election Results page posts Electionware summary and precinct-by-precinct ('PCTbyPCT') reports in several stages (Unofficial, Final Unofficial, Official). For both 2026 elections the unofficial precinct-by-precinct reports were uploaded after election night: primary PCTbyPCT created 10:51 PM CST election night but uploaded 9:47 AM CST Mar 4; runoff PCTbyPCT created 3:51 PM CDT May 28 and uploaded May 29. Election-night summary files (e.g. 'Unofficial_REP Primary Runoff_05262026.pdf', 'Summary Results_REP Primary_030326.pdf') were not opened. 2024 general: the earliest precinct file present is 'FinalPCTbyPCT11052024.pdf' (FINAL UNOFFICIAL RESULTS, created and uploaded Nov 13, 2024); the name implies earlier versions that are no longer posted, so the 2024 general is left UNDETERMINED (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not found on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED; 2026_runoff LATER to UNDETERMINED.
